signals.detail: HY spreads widening to 316bps with the S&P still up 2.3% on the month. Credit markets price default and financing risk more directly, which makes this divergence a useful independent warning rather than confirmation.
signals.title: Credit widening while equities hold

signals.detail: NFCI at -0.49 and tightening while Growth still reads Steady. Financial conditions lead activity, so this is the sequence that precedes a growth downgrade rather than confirming one.
signals.title: Conditions tightening ahead of growth

signals.detail: S&P up 2.3% over the month while equal-weight lags cap-weight by 3.0pp. The gain is concentrated in the largest names, which is a fragility signal, not a strength signal.
signals.title: Rally is narrow
